role: CoreLocation + CMAltimeter wrapper for workout GPS: requests When-In-Use auth, streams fixes with accuracy/jitter gates into a track and GPS distance, tracks pause steps, buffers barometric altitude samples and keeps a live elevation gain/loss estimate; forwards newest fix to AmbientLocationService.
types: WorkoutLocationManager: class (@Observable, @MainActor, NSObject) — workout GPS/barometer state
state: private: manager (CLLocationManager), altimeter (CMAltimeter), liveAltitudeReference, lastJitterLogAt, lastDroppedFixLogAt, lastRawBarometricAltitude, pausedAltitudeShift, trackSeededByRejectedFix
toplevel: Header comment describes While-Using authorization plus the location background mode (startTracking turns on allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates and the indicator) and that updates end when tracking stops. Created lazily by WorkoutRecorder.location (WorkoutRecorder.swift).

units.does: didSet of isPaused: when it flips from true to false (resume) inserts track.count into trackPauses.gaps so the next step (spanning the pause) contributes no time. Set by WorkoutSessionLifecycle.pause/resume (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift), resetState and startIfAuthorizedWhileWaiting.

branches.cond: oldValue true and new value false
branches.effect: inserts current track.count into trackPauses.gaps; otherwise nothing

units.does: Initialises: copies manager.authorizationStatus, sets itself as CLLocationManager delegate, kCLLocationAccuracyBest accuracy (not the navigation level meant for external power), no distance filter, activityType .fitness, pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically=false.
Calls requestWhenInUseAuthorization only when status is .notDetermined; no-op otherwise.

branches.effect: requests When-In-Use authorization
does nothing; a denied user gets no prompt and no feedback

units.does: If authorized: clears startsWhenAuthorized, wipes all state (resetState, which also clears isPaused), sets isTracking, configures background location, startUpdatingLocation and starts barometric updates, with step debug logs. If not authorized: sets startsWhenAuthorized only when status is .notDetermined, requests auth and returns (denied/restricted silently records no GPS). Called deferred from WorkoutSessionLifecycle.deferLocationTrackingStart, which skips it once the workout stopped and re-applies a pause taken meanwhile, and from startIfAuthorizedWhileWaiting, which also restores the pause.

branches.effect: records whether to start after the prompt (only if notDetermined), requests auth, returns without tracking; otherwise proceeds to reset and start

units.does: Sets allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates=true, pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically=false and showsBackgroundLocationIndicator=true, logging each step (watchdog-hang breadcrumbs).

Clears startsWhenAuthorized, stops location updates and altimeter updates, sets isTracking false; keeps track/distance for the caller to persist. Called by WorkoutRecorder stop (WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift).

Sets barometerAvailable from CMAltimeter.isRelativeAltitudeAvailable; if available starts relative-altitude updates on the main queue whose handler forwards relativeAltitude to ingestBarometricAltitude.

branches.effect: logs GPS-altitude fallback and returns
handler drops the update silently; otherwise ingests

units.does: CMAltimeter handler body: computes step from the previous raw reading; while paused accumulates the step into pausedAltitudeShift and returns; otherwise appends (Date(), raw-pausedAltitudeShift) to barometricSamples and advances the live accumulator. Timestamps use Date() at delivery, not the altimeter sample timestamp.
units.entry: CMAltimeter relative-altitude callback on main queue (via closure)

branches.effect: ?? uses raw itself so first step is 0
adds step to pausedAltitudeShift and returns without storing a sample; otherwise stores and advances

units.does: Deadband accumulator: first sample seeds liveAltitudeReference; later, once |current-reference| >= 3 m, the whole move is added to elevationGainMeters or elevationLossMeters and reference moves to current.

branches.effect: seeds the reference and returns
returns without banking
adds to gain; else adds -move to loss

units.does: Public wipe of all accumulated state via resetState. Called by resetRecorderStateAfterStop (WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift).

Clears currentLocation, distance, pause flag (didSet may insert a gap into the old trackPauses first), trackPauses, elevation gain/loss, live altitude reference, raw barometric reading/paused shift/buffer, jitter and dropped-fix log times, track and the seeded flag.

Per-fix ingest, only while tracking (a batch hopped to the main actor after stopTracking is dropped): records lastHorizontalAccuracy; unusable fixes are logged (at most one line a minute, logDroppedFix) and only seed an empty track; the first usable fix after a rejected seed replaces the track; otherwise credits movement from the previous fix (or appends the first fix); finally sets currentLocation (even when movement was rejected as jitter).

branches.effect: returns, fix ignored
logDroppedFix, seedTrackIfEmpty and return

branches.cond: track holds only a rejected seed fix
branches.effect: track = [location], clears seed flag (no distance credited)
creditMovement from it; else (empty track) appends the fix

units.does: True when 0 < horizontalAccuracy <= threshold (65 m); otherwise false. Logging the drop is the caller's (logDroppedFix).

branches.effect: false; otherwise true

units.does: Logs a dropped fix's accuracy and the threshold, at most once a minute by fix timestamp (indoors every fix is dropped, about one a second).

branches.cond: a drop was logged less than 60 s before this fix
branches.effect: nothing logged

units.does: Appends a rejected fix as a placeholder only when the track is empty, marks trackSeededByRejectedFix and sets currentLocation.

branches.effect: returns without change

units.does: Credits a step only when delta >= 3.5 m and >= noise floor (min(1.5x worst accuracy, 20 m)); rejected steps are logged and not appended. Accepted steps while paused mark the index in trackPauses.paused (no distance); otherwise add to distanceMeters and the GPS elevation fallback; the fix is appended either way.

branches.effect: logs jitter reject and returns (fix not appended)
marks step index as paused (route extends, no distance); otherwise adds distance and GPS elevation fallback

units.does: Returns min(max(current.accuracy, previous.accuracy) x multiplier, 20 m).
Only when no barometer: adds GPS altitude delta to gain/loss when |delta| >= 5 m.

branches.effect: returns (barometer owns gain/loss)
returns
adds to gain; else to loss

branches.effect: returns without logging; otherwise records time and logs

CLLocationManagerDelegate didFailWithError: ignores the transient .locationUnknown; logs any other error (denied permission, failed service) at warning level. GPS distance simply stops advancing either way.
